QuestInfo.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach III
QuestInfo.0: It seems that #p802# in #m10007000# wants to ask for another favor.
QuestInfo.1: I have to bring enough ingredients for 30 people to #p802# in #m10007000#.
QuestInfo.2: I worked a part-time gig gathering ingredients for meals for the tourists coming to #m10007000#.

0.0: Remember what I told you last time? I'll need a lot more ingredients since more tourists are booking here now. It may take you some time, although the amount of time will depend on your ability to get the job done. What do you think? Do you want to take a crack at it? You'll be paid quite well for this.

yes.0: All right, the visitors that are coming this time are quite something. They only want the specials, and #t4000032#s alone will not do. Because of that, I'll need #b30 #t4000061#s#k for the coconut juice, #b60 #t4000032#s#k and #b60 #t4000040#s#k for the main course, and #b30 #t4000031#s#k for the dessert.

no.0: Is it because I'm asking you for too much? Just remember, you'll be paid accordingly... if you feel like doing it, please come talk to me.

1.0: Did you gather up all the ingredients I asked you for? Well, let's see...

yes.0: I knew it!!! All the materials you've gathered up are fresh and ready to be served!! The customers will be more than satisfied with these. I don't think we'll ever have a huge group of visitors like this again. If I find something that needs doing, I'll definitely ask you for help. Thanks, and take care!

item.0: Please check and see if you have #b30 #t4000061#s#k, #b60 #t4000032#s#k, #b60 #t4000040#s#k, and #b30 #t4000031#s#k. I don't think you have all of them...
